examples.title: Six-digit verification code
examples.code:
import { PinInput } from "@moderno-ui/react";

<PinInput.Root count={6} otp>
  <PinInput.Control>
    <PinInput.Input index={0} />
  </PinInput.Control>
</PinInput.Root>

guidance.intent: Enter a short code the user received out of band — an SMS OTP or an emailed verification code.
guidance.whenToUse: A fixed-length code where each character deserves its own cell.
